items.question: Is the online safety report free?
items.answer: Yes. You can start with the online safety report at no cost. An in-home assessment visit costs {{visitFee}} and is credited if you proceed with agreed CasaMia improvements.

items.question: Do I have to install anything after the assessment?
items.answer: No. The assessment gives you clarity first. CasaMia explains what looks urgent, what can wait, and what would need a priced plan before installation is booked.

items.question: What does CasaMia manage if we continue?
items.answer: CasaMia can coordinate the whole plan: compatible products, insured installers, grant-application support where relevant, scheduling, safe-use explanation and follow-up.

items.question: Can we use photos, videos or a phone call before a visit?
items.answer: Yes. You can start online with guided answers, photos, short videos, voice notes or a call. If measurement or an on-site check is needed, you see the visit details before booking.

items.question: Can CasaMia help with public grants?
items.answer: CasaMia checks possible grant fit and prepares supporting documents when the programme matches the planned adaptations. The public authority decides eligibility, approval, amount and timing.

faq.title: Questions people ask before choosing a plan.

items.question: Which plan should I choose?
items.answer: If you are unsure, start with the free online safety report. If you need a professional visit, CasaMia will confirm the in-home assessment fee before booking.

items.question: Is the online safety report really free?
items.answer: Yes. The online photo-based safety report is free. A professional in-home assessment visit costs {{visitFee}}, credited toward your CasaMia plan if you proceed.

items.question: Do I have to proceed with installation after the assessment?
items.answer: No. You receive recommendations first, then decide what fits the home, the person using it and any approved contacts.

items.question: Are installers insured?
items.answer: CasaMia structures projects around insured professional installation, final checks and your approval before final payment.

items.question: When do I pay?
items.answer: The {{visitFee}} assessment fee includes {{visitVatPercent}} VAT and is paid in advance at booking. Installation plans use a clear {{proposalUpfrontPercent}} deposit and {{proposalBalancePercent}} final payment after completion and your approval.

items.question: Can the plan be personalised?
items.answer: Yes. The agreed adaptations are matched to the home, the person using it, and the safety priorities found during assessment.

items.question: Do you support smart safety devices?
items.answer: Yes. The Smart Safety Plan can include sensors, emergency response devices, smart lighting, access devices and setup support when they fit the home and consent is clear.

items.question: What happens after installation is completed?
items.answer: We explain how to use the changes safely, confirm you are happy with the installation and make clear who to contact if the home or routine changes later.

faqs.question: Can I control everything from my phone?
faqs.answer: Many devices can be controlled from a phone when compatible, but CasaMia limits the setup to controls the person can reliably use.

faqs.question: Do smart devices require Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Most smart devices require reliable Wi-Fi or connectivity. We review this during the assessment before recommending devices.

faqs.question: Will you train me to use the system?
faqs.answer: Yes. Training and safe-use guidance are part of the Smart Safety Plan.

faqs.question: Can additional devices be added later?
faqs.answer: Yes. The system can usually be expanded later as needs change, subject to compatibility.

grantManagement.title: Grant help: what CasaMia can and cannot do
grantManagement.body: CasaMia can help organise the grant file, but the public authority decides whether funding is available, whether the person qualifies and when a decision is made.

hero.title: Check grant fit before you plan the work.

what.title: Grant support depends on the call, the home and the paperwork.
what.body: Plan Adapta or similar local programmes may support certain accessibility and safety adaptations, but only when the authority, open call, applicant details, documents, timing and proposed work all fit. CasaMia helps you understand that fit before an application is prepared.

help.title: We turn the home need into a clearer grant file.

items.title: Fit check before paperwork
items.body: We check whether the person, home, timing and planned adaptations appear to match the grant rules before you spend time on forms.

items.title: Missing document list
items.body: We list what is missing, organise the documents provided and prepare the application file before submission.

items.title: Application forms
items.body: We complete the forms for the chosen grant channel using the agreed adaptations and customer information.

items.title: Coordination with authorities where authorised
items.body: Where the customer authorises it, CasaMia can liaise with the relevant authority about the application.

items.title: Adaptation wording
items.body: We describe the planned adaptations in practical terms: what will change, where, and why it supports safer use of the home.

items.title: Application tracking

disclaimer.title: Important: grant support is not guaranteed
disclaimer.body: Grant approval is determined solely by the relevant authority. CasaMia cannot guarantee eligibility, approval, funding level, processing time or whether work may begin before a decision.

steps.title: Start with the home need
steps.body: Use a CasaMia review so the room risks, measurements and likely adaptation needs are documented.

steps.body: A CasaMia specialist reviews the relevant rooms, access points, fitting conditions and safety concerns.

preview.title: See what a safer home can look like.
preview.body: Compare common risk points with practical changes for bathrooms, stairs, entrances, kitchens, bedrooms and living areas.

page.title: Before and after: safer daily routines at home
page.body: Use these examples to spot what may be making a room harder to use, then see the kind of practical change CasaMia can review.
page.galleryTitle: From everyday risk to safer daily routines
page.galleryBody: Each transformation shows the risk CasaMia looks for and the improvement that can be reviewed after a home safety assessment.

beforeAfter.disclaimer: These examples are a guide, not a final recommendation. CasaMia checks the room layout, measurements, routines and fitting conditions before confirming any work.

transformations.title: Bathroom safety
transformations.before: Wet-floor transfers with little reliable support around the shower or toilet.
transformations.after: Support points, slip-resistant surfaces and clearer movement through the daily bathroom routine.
benefits: Make shower and toilet transfers steadier

transformations.title: Stair safety
transformations.before: Steps that feel uncertain because support, contrast, or lighting is limited.
transformations.after: Continuous handrails, visible step edges and better light so each step is easier to judge.
benefits: Make step edges easier to see

transformations.title: Entrance access
transformations.before: Raised thresholds, narrow entry points or poor lighting when arriving or leaving.
transformations.after: A smoother, better-lit entrance with support where balance or mobility aids need it.
benefits: Add support for entry and exit

transformations.title: Kitchen safety
transformations.before: Busy routines can mean awkward reach, slippery areas, hot surfaces or cluttered routes.
transformations.after: Clearer work zones, safer reach, slip reduction, better light and appliance safeguards where needed.
benefits: Bring daily items within safer reach

transformations.title: Bedroom and night route
transformations.before: Getting in and out of bed can be harder when lighting, support or floor space is limited.
transformations.after: Better bedside light, clearer routes, stable support and a lower-risk path to the bathroom.
benefits: Clear the route to the bathroom

transformations.title: Living area safety
transformations.before: Chairs, rugs, cables and tight routes can make sitting, standing and moving less secure.
transformations.after: Clearer walking routes, safer seating height and support near the places used every day.
benefits: Reduce rug and cable trip risks
